args.body: Take WELFARE-OFFICIAL-AMENDMENT-CHECK as a single current-source refresh of existing decision-useful inventory. The economic purpose is preventing a provider from relying on superseded procurement facts. Check actual FETCH receipts and distinguish unchanged from inaccessible. No material change means stop, not another page revision or recurring audit. Three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown; refreshed facts establish neither acquisition nor revenue. Keep existing live experiments unchanged unless a material correction is independently reviewed and subsequently authorized through the host gate.

description: Feedback is available but contains no classified commercial events and three unclassified sources; demand remains unknown. Verified available funds are zero. Choose one bounded refresh of the existing time-sensitive welfare brief: official amendments could change a provider’s bid decision. Payment and participant-identity gaps block their dependent operations, not this public-source service work. Preserve live experiment windows and independent publication review.
